name: Kashidashi Tsuma, Marina no "Netorase" Houkoku Binkan Tsuma to Zetsurin Daigakusei
original_name: 貸し出し妻、満里奈の“ネトラセ”報告 敏感妻と絶倫大学生
source:
Azuma Kenji is a married man with a wife and child. One day, he reads someone's online account of their wife sleeping with another man, and it intrigues him.

What kind of sex would his wife, Marina, have with other men?

He decides that wants her to sleep with another man. Just once would be fine. At first, Marina refuses Kenji's request, but she finally caves in to his enthusiasm and agrees do it JUST ONCE.

She chooses to "loan herself" to Hiroto, a college student a decade her junior. Hiroto's the type of guy who triggers her maternal instinct. He has a habit of blowing his load quickly, but he's proud of the fact that he can easily rebound and go multiple rounds.

At first, their agreement is only for a single time, but Kenji, Marina, and Hiroto all soon become addicted. Eventually, the explicit wife-loaning play escalates to extremes, like bareback sex and all-night "loan-outs”. As Marina and Hiroto fall deeper and deeper into the play, Kenji has to ask himself: is his wife really his anymore? 

[Edited from [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1024]Official site[/url]]
translation:
东健二是一位已婚男人，有妻子和孩子。有一天，他在网上读到某人的妻子与另一个男人上床的报道，这引起了他的兴趣。

他的妻子玛丽娜会与其他男人发生什么样的性行为？

他决定要她和另一个男人上床。只要一次就好了。起初，玛丽娜拒绝了健二的请求，但她最终屈服于他的热情，同意只做一次。

她选择将自己“借给”比她小十岁的大学生广人。弘人是那种能激发她母性本能的人。他有快速爆发的习惯，但他为自己可以轻松反弹并进行多轮比赛而感到自豪。

起初，他们的协议只是一次，但Kenji、Marina和Hiroto很快就上瘾了。最终，露骨的借妻游戏升级到极端，比如无鞍性行为和通宵“借出”。随着玛丽娜和广人越陷越深，健二不得不问自己：他的妻子真的是他的了吗？
